source_path: Floom original, written 2026-11-01 as a generic version of the private post copy gate Federico De Ponte runs on every LinkedIn and X draft.
note: The method is Federico De Ponte's: deterministic checks that each come from a rejected draft, an edit-vs-rewrite check, a blind cold reader for line 1, and a rule added after every rejection. His own rejection history, banned names, partner rules and product numbers were removed; the shipped defaults are generic and the user grows their own rules file. gate.py was written by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code, standard library only, no network call.
